Based on the supplied evidence, here is the comparison of their regular-season career scoring statistics:

### Factual Evidence & Statistics

* **Michael Jordan:**
  * **Total Points:** 32,292 points [lebron_scoring_800]
  * **Games Played:** 1,072 games [lebron_scoring_800]
  * **Career Points Per Game (calculated):** Approximately **30.12 PPG** ($\frac{32,292 \text{ pts}}{1,072 \text{ gp}}$) [lebron_scoring_800]
  * **Scoring Accolades:** Won 10 scoring titles [jordan_scoring_0].

* **LeBron James:**
  * **Total Points:** 38,390 points (becoming the NBA's all-time scoring leader) [lebron_scoring_240], [lebron_scoring_640]
  * **Games Played:** 1,410 games [lebron_scoring_640]
  * **Career Points Per Game (calculated):** Approximately **27.23 PPG** ($\frac{38,390 \text{ pts}}{1,410 \text{ gp}}$) [lebron_scoring_640]
  * **Scoring Consistency:** Maintained scoring averages of at least 25 points per game in all 19 seasons following his rookie campaign [lebron_scoring_160], [lebron_scoring_240].

---

### Tradeoffs and Analysis

* **Per-Game Scoring vs. Longevity & Volume:** 
  * Jordan holds a clear advantage in regular-season per-game scoring rate (~30.12 PPG to LeBron's ~27.23 PPG) and peak scoring dominance with 10 scoring titles [jordan_scoring_0], [lebron_scoring_800].
  * LeBron demonstrates greater cumulative scoring and longevity, having played 1,410 games to surpass Kareem Abdul-Jabbar for the NBA all-time total points record (38,390 points) while sustaining an elite scoring threshold (25+ PPG) across 19 consecutive post-rookie seasons [lebron_scoring_160], [lebron_scoring_640].
* **Shooting Percentage:**
  * LeBron posted a career 50.5% field goal percentage across his 1,410 games [lebron_scoring_640].
  * Jordan recorded a career 49.7% field goal percentage across his 1,072 games [lebron_scoring_800].

---

### Subjective GOAT Judgments vs. Factual Records
From a strictly factual standpoint, Jordan generated a higher points-per-game average, whereas James accumulated more total points over a longer career span [lebron_scoring_240], [lebron_scoring_640], [lebron_scoring_800]. Determining whether Jordan's superior per-game rate and scoring titles or LeBron's sustained career longevity and all-time total scoring record carries more weight in "greatest of all time" discussions is a subjective evaluation rather than an objective statistical fact.
